name: Aha!
description_en:
Aha! is a family of product-development tools. This record focuses on Aha! Roadmaps: defining product strategy, linking planned work to goals, prioritizing features and communicating release plans. A feature is a structured work record, not just a shape on a presentation. Releases group work around a date, while epics group it around a theme.

For a product manager, the useful question is whether one connected model can replace disconnected strategy notes, feature lists and roadmap slides. Roadmaps is distinct from Aha! Develop for engineering work and Aha! Teamwork for project delivery. The sections below explain the planning model and package conditions without treating the whole Aha! suite as one included subscription.
description_zh:
Aha! 是一个产品开发工具家族。本文重点研究 Aha! Roadmaps：制定产品策略、把计划工作关联到目标、确定功能优先级，以及沟通发布计划。这里的 feature 是结构化工作记录，并非演示文稿上的一个图形。Release 按日期组织工作，epic 则按主题组织工作。

对于产品经理，值得评估的是能否用一个相互关联的模型，取代分散的策略笔记、功能清单和路线图幻灯片。Roadmaps 与用于工程工作的 Aha! Develop、用于项目交付的 Aha! Teamwork 各有职责。以下说明规划模型和套餐条件，不把整个 Aha! 家族当作一份订阅默认包含的功能。

sections.title_en: Connect a feature to the reason for building it
sections.title_zh: 把功能与开发理由关联
sections.en:
A hypothetical retention initiative might contain a feature for improving account onboarding. Create the initiative, connect it to a goal, then link the feature and place it in the intended release. The initiative has an accountable owner even when its linked work has different assignees. This preserves the distinction between strategic responsibility and individual delivery assignments.

Start with one initiative rather than recreating the organization’s entire hierarchy. Ask whether a stakeholder can navigate from the proposed feature to its strategic reason and whether the owner is clear. These are evaluation criteria, not evidence that the plan will achieve retention gains.
sections.zh:
假设有一项提升留存的举措，其中包含改进账户入门流程的功能。可以先创建举措、关联目标，再链接该功能并放入预定发布版本。即使关联工作的受派人员各不相同，举措仍有一位总负责人，从而区分策略责任和具体交付分派。

建议从一项举措开始，而不是一次重建整个组织层级。检查利益相关者能否从待开发功能找到策略依据，以及负责人是否明确。这是评估标准，不能证明该计划会带来留存收益。

sections.title_en: Features, epics and releases serve different purposes
sections.title_zh: 功能、史诗与发布版本职责不同
sections.en:
The feature record can contain descriptions, requirements and attachments. An epic organizes a theme; a release organizes work around a release date. Roadmaps also offers configured status synchronization between related records. Choose those relationships deliberately instead of assuming every parent status follows every child automatically.

The feature documentation warns that converting a feature to another record type may lose information. Before reorganizing an existing backlog, inspect a representative conversion and compare fields. This warning concerns record conversion, not ordinary editing or moving a card between release columns.
sections.zh:
功能记录可包含描述、需求和附件。Epic 用来组织主题，release 用来围绕发布日期组织工作。Roadmaps 也提供相关记录之间可配置的状态同步；应主动选择关系，不能假定所有父记录状态都会自动跟随所有子记录。

功能文档警告，将功能转换成其他记录类型可能丢失信息。重组已有待办清单前，应先检查一条代表性转换并比对字段。这项警告针对记录类型转换，不是普通编辑或在发布列之间移动卡片。

sections.title_en: A roadmap is a view of the underlying records
sections.title_zh: 路线图是底层记录的视图
sections.en:
Different audiences need different detail. A features roadmap can show the release and its included work; Now, Next, Later can communicate sequence before detailed dates are settled. Choose the view based on the planning question the audience needs answered.

The documentation permits precise internal release dates and broader external dates such as a month or quarter. Check which fields and features appear in exported views. Save a customized roadmap: the documentation says an unsaved one is automatically deleted after 14 days. A shareable view still requires an intentional disclosure decision.
sections.zh:
不同读者需要不同细节。功能路线图可以展示发布版本及所含工作；Now、Next、Later 则适合在详细日期尚未确定时沟通先后顺序。应按读者需要回答的规划问题选择视图。

文档允许内部采用精确发布日期，对外则显示月份或季度。应检查导出视图包含哪些字段和功能，并保存定制后的路线图；文档说明，未保存的定制路线图会在 14 天后自动删除。能够分享视图，也仍需主动判断可披露范围。

sections.title_en: Roadmaps is not the entire Aha! product family
sections.title_zh: Roadmaps 与产品家族的边界
sections.en:
Aha! assigns different jobs to its products: Discovery manages customer research, Ideas handles feedback, Develop supports engineering, and Teamwork handles project work. Whiteboards and Knowledge can also exist as standalone tools while integrating with other Aha! products.

This matters when a requirement says “we need customer interviews” or “engineers must manage sprints.” First identify the responsible product and required edition. Do not infer entitlement from seeing its name in an Aha! navigation menu. This profile does not independently evaluate those neighboring products or approve any catalog alternative relationship.
sections.zh:
Aha! 将不同职责分配给不同产品：Discovery 管理客户研究，Ideas 处理反馈，Develop 支持工程工作，Teamwork 管理项目工作。Whiteboards 和 Knowledge 既可独立使用，也可与其他 Aha! 产品结合。

当需求是“管理客户访谈”或“让工程师管理迭代”时，这一点尤其重要。应先识别负责该任务的产品及所需版本，不能因为 Aha! 导航菜单出现某个名称就推定已购买。本档案没有独立评估这些相邻产品，也没有批准目录中的替代关系。

sections.title_en: Compare user roles as well as headline prices
sections.en:
The current pricing page lists Premium, Enterprise and Enterprise+. The retrieved price display combines monthly and annual numbers in one text stream, so this profile leaves a normalized price unset. Enterprise+ includes capabilities such as automation rules and team capacity planning that should not be assumed in Premium.

The pricing FAQ says Premium bills all users, while Enterprise and Enterprise+ bill workspace owners and contributors and include unlimited reviewers/viewers. Estimate the role mix before comparing plans. Reviewers still have workspace-permission boundaries; a zero additional license charge is not unrestricted access.
sections.zh:
当前定价页列出 Premium、Enterprise 和 Enterprise+。读取到的价格文本将月付和年付数字放在同一段中，因此本文不填写统一标准化价格。Enterprise+ 包含自动化规则、团队容量规划等能力，不能假定 Premium 默认提供。

定价 FAQ 说明，Premium 对全部用户计费；Enterprise 和 Enterprise+ 对工作区所有者与贡献者计费，包含不限数量的审阅者／查看者。比较套餐前应估算角色组合。审阅者仍受工作区权限约束，不增加许可证费用不等于拥有无限制访问权。

sections.title_en: A trial and AI access have separate limits
sections.title_zh: 试用与 AI 使用各有条件
sections.en:
Aha! documents a 30-day Roadmaps trial with Enterprise features and no credit card required. If the customer does not buy after the trial, the account expires; this is not a sustained free plan. The trial account becomes the continuing account when a plan is purchased.

Paid plans include a shared AI-credit pool whose use depends on request complexity; additional credits can be purchased. A named AI assistant is therefore not a claim of unlimited AI execution. Recheck the intended paid plan before relying on trial-enabled features, and include any required Aha! add-on users in the estimate.
sections.zh:
Aha! 说明 Roadmaps 可试用 30 天，开放 Enterprise 功能，无需信用卡。试用后不购买，账户会到期，因此这不是可持续免费套餐。购买套餐后，可以继续使用原试用账户。

付费套餐包含共享 AI 积分池，消耗取决于请求复杂度，也可额外购买积分。因此，提供 AI 助手不表示 AI 执行不限量。应在试用结束前重新核对准备购买的套餐，并将需要的 Aha! 附加模块用户计入预算。

sections.title_zh: 验证规划到交付的交接
sections.en:
Features can be sent to a supported two-way development integration, with status and progress returned. The general feature introduction establishes that model, but it does not establish every connector’s fields, conflict policy or retry behavior. Some linked detailed help pages required login or failed to load during this research; no connector was executed.

Shortlist Roadmaps when the product team needs strategy-to-feature traceability and different stakeholder views. If the immediate need is only a personal task list or a developer sprint board, establish whether a separate planning layer is justified. Begin with one workspace, one feature and one receiving team, then verify an update in both directions before broad rollout.
sections.zh:
功能可以发送到受支持的双向开发集成，并接收状态和进度更新。功能概述文档确立了这种模式，但不能据此确定每个连接器的字段、冲突策略或重试方式。本次研究中，部分详细帮助链接要求登录或读取失败；没有实际运行连接器。

当产品团队需要从策略追踪到功能，并面向不同利益相关者提供视图时，可以列入候选。如果当前只需个人任务清单或开发迭代看板，应先判断额外规划层是否值得。建议从一个工作区、一项功能和一个接收团队开始，验证双向更新后再扩大范围。
